title: Controlled activation of PHS cloud authentication for hybrid test users
purpose: Activate a previously prepared cloud authentication path when an approved hybrid authentication design needs switchover, then prove fresh sign-ins and rollback for synthetic users only.

scope.permittedTarget: An explicitly allow-listed isolated test tenant, test domain, synchronization instance and disposable synthetic hybrid users.
scope.notAClaim: Pre-synchronizing password hashes does not automatically switch a federated/PTA domain or user to cloud authentication. Activation, routing/propagation, fresh sign-in testing and rollback are separate operations. Existing sessions do not prove switchover.
excluded: Actual federation/PTA outage or service stop
Assuming unsynchronized recent password changes work
Assuming emergency cloud access works without R1 evidence

sourceReferences.qualification: PHS reduces runtime reliance on on-premises authentication when cloud authentication is actually activated and synchronized hashes are current. Confirm exact supported conversion/staged-rollout path for the approved authentication mode.
Independent administration, reversible changes and evidence are prerequisites, not proof this exercise ran.

prerequisites.requirement: Approval names tenant, domain, user cohort, sync instance, exact supported activation mechanism, operation window and rollback owner.
prerequisites.evidence: Scope/allow-list and reviewed current vendor procedure.

prerequisites.requirement: Independent cloud-only administration has been successfully verified within the approved scope and is available without the hybrid path.
prerequisites.evidence: Authorized R1 evidence and current custody/health record.

prerequisites.requirement: PHS is legally acceptable, enabled for the relevant scope, healthy, and has synchronized all synthetic users within the approved password RPO.
prerequisites.evidence: Sync settings, current successful per-scope cycle, timestamps and non-secret synthetic-user inventory; never password/hash contents.

prerequisites.requirement: Record current federation/PTA/cloud configuration, applicable Conditional Access and app-specific authentication dependencies; confirm staged rollout versus full domain conversion is appropriate.
prerequisites.evidence: Trusted redacted pre-change export and exact rollback plan tied to the selected supported mechanism.

prerequisites.requirement: Synthetic test matrix includes ordinary user, recently synchronized password change, deliberately unsynchronized change, disabled user, excluded user and protected administrator policies.
prerequisites.evidence: Synthetic cohort manifest with expected outcomes and no credentials.

prerequisites.requirement: Fresh private sign-in sessions, correlation IDs, sign-in diagnostics, sync logs, independent monitoring and approved timing thresholds are available.
prerequisites.evidence: Observer readiness and app-specific acceptance objectives.

dependencyLimits.dependency: Entra authentication, cloud routing, network, DNS, time and applicable policies
dependencyLimits.failureBehavior: PHS does not remove these cloud/service dependencies; stop or invoke a separately scoped incident process.
Last synchronized credential/state may differ from on-premises state; treat stale state as a known residual risk and test the approved deny path.
Cloud sign-in success is not proof those applications continue; validate each in-scope app or mark untested.
Do not interpret enabled PHS, an existing token or the first successful user as universal cutover.

steps.action: Check authorization, exact targets, current platform instructions and rollback window; establish UTC start and approved RTO/RPO/propagation bounds.
steps.expected: No ambiguity over scope or supported activation path.
steps.onFailure: Stop; do not infer authorization from available credentials.

steps.action: Read and retain redacted baseline mode/routing, synchronization health and applicable test-user policy before any change.
steps.expected: Reversible baseline and current hash/state synchronization are known.
steps.onFailure: Stop; stale or unknown PHS cannot be a resilient fallback claim.

steps.action: Verify approved independent emergency access and monitoring are available; record a fresh baseline test-user sign-in path.
steps.expected: Recovery administration and pre-cutover auth path are observed, not assumed.

steps.action: Activate cloud authentication for only the approved synthetic cohort/domain using the pre-reviewed supported mechanism. Record configuration change and propagation start; do not stop federation/PTA or alter networks.
steps.expected: The explicit activation/routing change, not hash pre-sync alone, selects cloud authentication for the approved scope.
steps.onFailure: Stop new changes and invoke the recorded mechanism-specific rollback.

steps.action: After the approved propagation checks, create fresh private sessions for each permitted synthetic user and access the exact test application.
steps.expected: Ordinary and synchronized-password users perform fresh successful cloud password sign-ins; event method/routing confirms PHS instead of federation/PTA or cached sessions.
steps.onFailure: Record per-user actual result and elapsed time; do not weaken policies to make the test pass.

steps.action: Execute the approved negative matrix: excluded user, disabled user, unsynchronized password change, and policy-protected access. Use only declared test credentials through normal entry; never record them.
steps.expected: Outcomes match documented sync-state and policy expectations. A stale credential or unpropagated disablement is recorded as a residual exposure, not hidden.
steps.onFailure: Treat unintended access as failure and rollback/contain only the approved scope.

steps.action: Correlate sign-in, audit and sync events; measure activation-to-fresh-sign-in time and password/state age. List apps not actually exercised.
steps.expected: A bounded measured result exists per user/app; no evidence claims automatic failover or complete on-premises outage survival.
steps.onFailure: Mark unmet criteria and preserve failed observations.

steps.action: Restore the pre-approved baseline routing/mode using the recorded supported rollback path, or retain the new mode only if that explicit decision was in the approval. Wait for documented propagation.
steps.expected: Final authentication mode and intended scope equal the approved end state.
steps.onFailure: Use independent administration and stop escalation; do not attempt a tenant-wide repair.

steps.action: Repeat fresh sign-in and negative controls after rollback, reconcile all synthetic objects and obtain scoped acceptance.
steps.expected: Rollback works for the exact cohort and no unrelated identities/configuration changed.
steps.onFailure: Keep validation failed and record remaining remediation.

trigger: Fresh sign-in routing/method cannot be proven
Any unexpected allow/deny or scope expansion
steps: Freeze changes and retain current mode, event IDs and time.
Use independent approved administration and the mechanism-specific baseline to reverse the allow-listed rollout/conversion only.
Wait for propagation and perform fresh ordinary plus negative test sign-ins.
Confirm the original test-domain mode, cohort membership, policies and app paths; escalate if rollback is not observed.
acceptance: Fresh rollback sign-ins and expected denies observed

passCriteria: Hash/state pre-sync freshness proven without exposing credential material
Explicit supported activation and propagation observed
Fresh successful sign-ins demonstrate intended cloud method for every required positive case
Negative and recently changed state cases match documented expectations
failCriteria: Enabled PHS or synchronized hashes presented as automatic failover
Only a cached token or one user tested
Unintended access, stale state outside accepted scope or unapproved production impact
evidenceRequirements: Redacted baseline and final mode/configuration with hashes
Per-user/app fresh positive and negative sign-in events
Rollback evidence and explicit app/identity coverage gaps

expected: Observed PHS activation, fresh sign-ins, negative controls and rollback within a separately authorized synthetic hybrid lab.
validation.blocker: Local-only fixtures/browser tests are authorized; no Entra/AD/PHS test domain, switchover or service interruption is authorized.
